parameters.name: CategoryId
parameters.description: The ID of the target leaf folder. Specify either this parameter or CategoryPath (this parameter takes priority). You can query the ID by calling ListAssetCategories. If neither this parameter nor CategoryPath is specified, the operation only unbinds the existing folder of the table.

parameters.name: CategoryPath
parameters.description: The path of the target folder (levels separated by /). The path locates existing folders level by level, with a maximum depth of 4 levels. The final folder must be a leaf folder.

parameters.name: CreateMissingCategory
parameters.description: Specifies whether to create folders level by level if the folder specified by CategoryPath does not exist. Default value: false, which returns a 404 error to prevent accidental folder creation from an incorrect path.

parameters.name: DbId
parameters.description: The database ID. You can call the [ListDatabases](~~141873~~) operation to query the database ID.

parameters.name: ParentCategoryId
parameters.description: The ID of the parent folder from which CategoryPath starts. Leave empty to start from the root folder.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The tenant ID.
> You can view the tenant ID by hovering over the profile icon in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see [View tenant information](~~181330~~).
